<header>諸般般若經第一卷上 一百九十三</header>
<warning>The main text is in vertical Manchu (or possibly Mongolian) script, printed from woodblocks in red ink inside a double-ruled frame. It is not transcribed here because a reliable letter-by-letter reading into Unicode could not be guaranteed. The red ink and the Chinese margin title suggest the Qianlong-era Manchu Kanjur, but this is an inference. The Chinese characters in the right margin are transcribed.</warning>
<meta>The page is a landscape pothi leaf with a double-ruled red border. The left margin has a short vertical label in the same script, probably the volume title and folio. The right margin has the Chinese title and folio number. Some ink faults appear along the top border on the right.</meta>
